description: This file defines the interface and data structures for managing Direct Rendering Manager (DRM) Kernel Mode Setting (KMS) operations, including context setup, cleanup, property retrieval, and plane management for display devices.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Creates and initializes a KMS context using the provided DRM device file descriptor.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with a given KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Sets up the encoder associated with the given DRM device and updates the KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Sets up the connector associated with the given DRM device and updates the KMS context.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Sets up the CRTC (display controller) associated with the given DRM device and updates the KMS context.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from a DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Retrieves the primary and overlay plane IDs, updating the KMS context.
